entries.id: negative:通用人體防護:基礎肢體崩壞防護:0
legacyIds: negative:通用人體防護:基礎肢體崩壞防護:0
entries.en: deformed, bad anatomy, disfigured, poorly drawn face, mutation, mutated, ugly, disgusting
entries.desc: 最基礎且必備的防護牆。防止 AI 隨機生成嚴重扭曲的人體結構或面部器官。

entries.id: negative:通用人體防護:手部與手指變異防護:1
legacyIds: negative:通用人體防護:手部與手指變異防護:1
entries.en: bad hands, missing fingers, extra digit, fewer digits, poorly drawn hands, twisted fingers, fused fingers
entries.desc: 針對 AI 最弱的「手部細節」加強防護，避免出現六根手指、手指融合或不合邏輯的折疊。

entries.id: negative:通用人體防護:腿部與關節防護:2
legacyIds: negative:通用人體防護:腿部與關節防護:2
entries.en: missing legs, extra legs, bad feet, twisted legs, broken bone, unnatural posture, disconnected limbs
entries.desc: 避免站姿或坐姿時，腿部憑空消失、多出一條腿，或是關節朝反方向彎折。

entries.id: negative:通用人體防護:頸部與頭部防護:3
legacyIds: negative:通用人體防護:頸部與頭部防護:3
entries.en: long neck, detached head, weird jaw, out of frame head, multiple heads, elongated face
entries.desc: 避免頭部與身體脫節、脖子異常拉長如蛇，或是同一個畫面上出現多顆頭顱。

entries.id: negative:通用人體防護:五官細節防護:4
legacyIds: negative:通用人體防護:五官細節防護:4
entries.en: cross-eyed, asymmetric eyes, weird eyes, missing nose, bad teeth, malformed lips, unrealistic facial proportions
entries.desc: 強制五官對稱，避免鬥雞眼、大小眼，或是張嘴時出現恐怖的牙齒結構。
